messages.author: a5e83218c834e013
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Initial Value Rejection with CVODE
parts:
Stan is like any other C++ program and can be run through GDB with enough
effort, although you’ll have to be careful because of all the templates.  Print
statements are typically much faster than trying to following GDB as it bounces
between Stan and CVODE.

The -1 error states that CVODE hit the max_num_steps threshold that you
specified (See Section B.2 of the CVODE manual), which is not uncommon
out in the tails of the parameters. You can increase the threshold from 1e6 to
1e8 or the like or find a better initial condition, but your model looks sufficiently 
complex that I would step back and start with something simpler.  The bounds
are not helping anything — use soft contains with priors instead.  The 1e-11
in the ODE specification is a sure sign that you can rescale your parameters
so that they’re all O(1) which could make huge improvements.
